report.interpretation: Follow-up to the Q2 2026 overall average claim cost ($9,560). "That" means average claim cost (incurred = paid + open reserves, divided by claim count, by loss date), for loss dates 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30, now split by product (auto and home).
report.answer: In Q2 2026, home claims averaged about $14,152 across 461 claims. Auto claims averaged about $6,269 across 643 claims. Home claims cost roughly 2.3 times as much as auto claims. The overall $9,560 is a blend of the two. Bodily injury and liability claims are reported late, and open reserves are still estimates, so these averages may shift a little.
report.answer_sql: WITH pay AS (SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id) SELECT c.product, sum(coalesce(pay.paid,0)+c.reserve_amount)/count(*) AS avg_claim_cost, count(*) AS claims FROM claims c LEFT JOIN pay USING (claim_id) WHERE c.loss_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-04-01' AND DATE '2026-06-30' GROUP BY c.product ORDER BY c.product

WITH source AS (
    SELECT c.*, p.channel, p.metro,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) AS paid_to_date,
           coalesce(pay.paid, 0) + c.reserve_amount AS incurred,
           c.close_date - c.report_date AS days_to_close
    FROM claims c
    JOIN policies p USING (policy_id)
    LEFT JOIN (
        SELECT claim_id, sum(amount) AS paid FROM claim_payments GROUP BY claim_id
    ) pay USING (claim_id)
)
SELECT product, sum(incurred) / count(*) AS value
FROM source
WHERE loss_date >= DATE '2026-04-01'
  AND loss_date <= DATE '2026-06-30'
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY ALL
